_about: Limits for scripts/perf-budget.cjs: highest of several local runs (2026-11-16, wave 8, 25 live zombies, 1280x720) plus about 10%. Zombie variants are random, so nodes and casters wobble by about 1% between runs. Exceptions: lightsTotal and lightsVisible are EXACT (CLAUDE.md fixes the light count). programs is the highest reading over the frame, after a real shot and after swapping through every weapon. Raise a limit only on purpose, in the same PR as the change that needs it, and say why.
